card.name: Last word before a sentence ends
card.fires_on: The final word of a clause or sentence, just before a period or comma, in drug-label text. Typical cases are 'as soon as possible', 'pregnant woman', 'females and males', and 'is unknown'.

modes.label: Warning sentence end
modes.description: The last word of the boxed fetal toxicity instruction, right before the period.
modes.example: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan tablets as soon as<< possible>>. ( 5.1 ) Drugs

modes.label: Closing noun or adjective
modes.description: The final word of a label statement about patients or testing, before the period.
modes.example: Chronic use of opioids may cause reduced fertility in females and<< males>> of reproductive potential.

modes.label: Scripture clause end
modes.description: The final word of a quoted clause in a Bible passage, before a comma.
modes.example: I will put my laws on their hearts, and write them on their<< minds>>,' then he adds, 'I

card.writes: It lowers the odds of dash punctuation, so the sentence is more likely to end with a period or comma instead.
card.plain: It marks the last word of a sentence and makes the model expect the sentence to stop rather than continue with a dash.
